# Hand-written genomes that put INT_MIN (one, then 31 shift-l) into the
# register an experimental (hw_type 3) instruction folds with abs(): the
# C++ abs(INT_MIN) stays INT_MIN, and the compiled code then reduces it as
# an unsigned value (set-forage-target and show-ft: unsigned % with the
# forage-target count; look-around / look-around-ft: unsigned % 3;
# rotate-x: & 7; deposit-resource / nop-deposit-resource: an unsigned
# compare with the stored amount), while get-res-stored keeps the signed
# division. Traced by the C++ reference (cbuild/work/avida -a, analyze
# LOAD_SEQUENCE... + TRACE trace_out/ 0 -1 0) with the
# tests/fixtures/exp_env/ft1 config and the instruction set below
# (INSTSET diff:hw_type=3). The deposit genomes end on `zero` so that the
# next deposit does not index GetRBins() with -1.
# SEQ <sequence> <fnv1a64 of the trace> <trace length in bytes>
BATCH fixed
INST nop-A
INST nop-B
INST nop-C
INST nop-D
INST nop-E
INST nop-F
INST nop-G
INST nop-H
INST one
INST shift-l
INST set-forage-target
INST get-forage-target
INST show-ft
INST zero
INST inc
INST collect-specific
INST nop-deposit-resource
INST deposit-resource
INST get-res-stored
INST look-around
INST look-around-ft
INST rotate-x
